subject: MAP kickoff & contracting cadence for Medica evaluation
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@medicahealth.com>, procurement@medicahealth.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff & contracting cadence for Medica evaluation

Hi Jared & Medica team —

Thanks again for the time last week. As promised, I’m kicking off a short MAP (mutual action plan) so we can align on evaluation milestones, contracting checkpoints, and the redline process. Attached you’ll find a first-pass MAP PDF and an evaluation framework that our solutions engineer will use during the POC.

High-level ask: can Medica confirm the procurement/legal owner who will receive redlines and the expected internal review SLAs (e.g., 3–5 business days)? This will help us map realistic contract milestones and lock in a go/no-go date.

Proposed initial milestones (draft):
- Week 0 (Nov 15): MAP kickoff + intake docs (attached)
- Week 1: Evaluation plan kickoff call + access provisioning
- Week 2–3: POC + interim check-in
- Week 4: Contract redline window + legal review
- Week 5: Final sign + provisioning/hand-off

Please find the attachments: MAP_Medica_v1.pdf, Evaluation_Framework.xlsx, and a short Redline_Process_Guide.docx that outlines how we prefer to receive comments (Track Changes vs. consolidated markups vs. DocuSign workflow).

Next steps from our side: I’ll schedule a 30-minute MAP kickoff for Tue/Wed next week and invite relevant folks. Rishi (legal/terms) and Marcus (CS/ops) are on copy to own contracting and deployment milestones.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): MAP_Medica_v1.pdf (PDF), Evaluation_Framework.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redline_Process_Guide.docx (docx)

From: LegalOps Team <legalops@medicahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@medicahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@medicahealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & contracting cadence for Medica evaluation

Hi Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear plan and the attachments. Quick answers from LegalOps: our primary contracts contact for this project will be me (LegalOps inbox) and I’ll loop in Sarah Price (in-house counsel) for the redline review. We typically target 3 business days for an initial intake acknowledgement and 5–7 business days for a full legal review depending on complexity. If there are negotiated data or security clauses, that can extend the cycle.

A few clarifying Qs before the kickoff meeting:
- Do you expect a single consolidated redline document (preferred) or parallel markups?
- Will Greenwood (your SOC contact) be available to confirm security language during review?

We can do Tue 17 Nov 10:00–11:00 EST for the kickoff or Wed 18 Nov 14:00–15:00 EST. 

Best,
LegalOps Team (on behalf of Sarah Price)
Medica Health
Attachment(s): none

To: LegalOps Team <legalops@medicahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@medicahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & contracting cadence for Medica evaluation

Hi LegalOps —

Thanks for the fast reply and for confirming the review cadence. I’ll own the contracting thread from Redwood’s side. A couple notes on process to make reviews efficient: 

Preferred redline workflow from Redwood: consolidated redline (single doc) + a one-page cover memo that explains any non-standard terms we expect to negotiate (data residency, log retention, audit access). If you prefer DocuSign for execution, we can support that — please indicate any signature authority thresholds.

Security contact: Alex Greenwood (alex_greenwood@redwood.com) will be available during legal review to answer specific SOC/technical questions. I’ll copy Alex into the contract thread once we have the initial redline.

Contract milestones I propose (we’ll mirror these in the MAP doc):
- Legal intake acknowledgement: 3 business days after we submit consolidated redline
- Target substantive response / counter-redline: 5 business days after intake
- Final negotiation window: 3 business days after counter-redline

I’m ok with Tue 17 Nov 13:00–13:30 PST (16:00–16:30 EST) for a short kickoff if that works for Medica.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Contracting, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & contracting cadence for Medica evaluation

Kimberly / Rishi —

Thanks — Tue 17 Nov 16:00–16:30 EST works for us (I know there were multiple timezones; this maps to 13:00–13:30 PST). I’ll accept the invite and make sure Sarah Price and procurement are on the line.

Quick procurement note: our target close for this POC evaluation is Dec 10 so we can align budget and deployment planning for Q1. We’d like the redline window to be complete by Nov 29 to keep that timeline. If Redwood can commit to the milestone cadence Rishi outlined, that should be fine.

Also, we prefer consolidated redlines and DocuSign for the final signature. Please send the consolidated doc to legalops@medicahealth.com and cc procurement.

Cheers,
Jared
Director, Technical Programs
Medica Health

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & contracting cadence for Medica evaluation — recap & next steps

Thanks everyone for the fast alignment on the call — appreciate Medica’s timelines and the clear contracting preferences. Quick recap and agreed actions: 

Action owners & due dates:
- Redwood to submit consolidated redline + cover memo (Rishi) — due Nov 22 COB PT
- LegalOps to acknowledge intake within 3 business days of Nov 22 submission (LegalOps)
- Alex Greenwood (Redwood security) to be available for SOC questions during Nov 23–25 window (Alex)
- CS/ops runbook handoff & access checklist (Marcus) — draft by Nov 24
- Final redline closure target: Nov 29 (both sides)

Attachments: I’ve uploaded the MAP_Medica_v1.pdf and Evaluation_Framework.xlsx to the shared Drive link and attached the Redline_Process_Guide for quick reference. We’ll send a consolidated redline document and a short cover memo on Nov 22. If Medica wants to use DocuSign for execution, Rishi will coordinate the template and signer list.

If anyone needs changes to the milestone dates to meet internal procurement cycles, please flag them ASAP — otherwise we’ll proceed to the Nov 22 submission.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): Redline_Process_Guide.docx (docx)
